reviewer: Codex active agent, same author; provisional self-review

dimensions.name: business-specificity
dimensions.evidence: The ledger line and service sequence frame a monthly bookkeeping offer, and the callout names the transaction-volume review before pricing.

dimensions.name: composition
dimensions.evidence: A narrow index rail balances the large service statement; alternating ledger rows pull the eye from the offer into the three-step monthly process.

dimensions.name: typography
dimensions.evidence: The display serif distinguishes the proposition from the compact sans labels; paragraphs keep readable line lengths and the mobile headings do not clip.

dimensions.name: media-integration
dimensions.evidence: With no approved photography in the synthetic brief, ruled lines, numbered entries, and a restrained account-table pattern carry the visual evidence without implying a real client or product screen.

dimensions.name: brand-coherence
dimensions.evidence: Warm paper, navy type, and copper accents recur on both routes; the interior applies the same ledger grid without repeating the home layout verbatim.

dimensions.name: copy-design-integration
dimensions.evidence: The section hierarchy follows the offer, exclusions, monthly workflow, and fit-call action; the small-print scope stays beside its associated service statement.

dimensions.name: responsive-craft
dimensions.evidence: The mobile capture uses a separate navigation row, keeps the numbered sequence in reading order, and shows no clipped text or sideways overflow.
